name: Spanish B2.1
description: In this module, students will increase their knowledge of Spanish as a foreign language, enabling them to actively and fluently communicate with a native speaker on topics of general interest or in familiar fields using logically-structured arguments. Students develop a broad and differentiated vocabulary on a broad range of topical issues. They learn/practice among other things how to quote other people; how to make requests and give orders; how to express agreement and disagreement. To do this, the necessary grammar will be covered.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of level B1.2; placement test result B2.1
